answer: The fee is charged through an atlas debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the juniper totals, and the dune anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. At 40 units per epoch, sustaining 273 aliases for 50 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the adversary. Each active identity burns a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. That is 14 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
